independence.review_method: The pinned repair3 subject, declarative contract, evidence, implementation receipt, V9 blueprint, adjudicated repair2 docket, and primary Bikeshed/WHATWG semantics were checked directly. Every repair and verifier claim was treated as unproved until a bounded replay or counterexample established it.
independence.qualification: The repair2 root docket names the rejected union that repair3 claims to close; no repair3 review B was read. This challenge is based on fresh repair3 inputs and mutations.

facts_used: Section 8.1 permits biblio modifiers in any order, and section 7.2 permits a visible-text suffix such as [[CSS-FOO|the CSS Foo spec]].
The shared autolink inside syntax permits an empty slash for an explicitly for-less definition, as in [=/url=], and a vertical-bar visible-text segment that is not part of the target.
Markup Shorthands is a comma-separated metadata list; the l element recognizes every autolink syntax even when that category is disabled.
Any a element without an href attribute is a manual autolink; link text and type attributes are optional because their defaults come from text content and dfn.
All dfn attributes can be inherited from ancestors, taking the closest value per attribute; recognized defining elements are dfn and h2 through h6.
Datablocks initially jump to their closing tag without interpreting Bikeshed shorthands; their DSL determines replacement, and data-source blocks disappear.

whatwg_html_syntax.fact_used: The empty-attribute syntax gives an attribute the empty-string value; a source-level href token without '=' is present, not absent.

temporary_cwd.classification: CWD-independent bounded replay only; not a relocated or authenticated transitive runtime closure.

retained_green_controls.area: bibliographic modifiers and adjacent definition whitespace
retained_green_controls.result: The exact [[ABC current]], [[CSS-VALUES-4 status]], [=foo / bar=], [=foo/ bar=], and [=foo /bar=] witnesses behave as declared.

retained_green_controls.area: duplicate-name close recovery and processed depth
retained_green_controls.result: Both STALE_STACK witnesses retain the two processed-code references in PROCESSED_CODE and leave the post-code reference in VISIBLE_TEXT; no fresh failure was found in the repaired suffix removal loop.
The frozen ordinary-pre, explicit-l definition, anchors datablock shorthand, and css-no single-quote witnesses pass exactly.
The exact entity-decoded absolute URL, relative query, and dfn-for scope witnesses preserve raw_value while using decoded semantic values.
A REJECTED status is excluded with LEDGER_REVIEW_STATUS, and an admitted operation ID equal to a candidate ID is reported as a union collision.
The closed nested section witness assigns the later explicit operation to Outer, and an uppercase HTTPS URL is included.

adversarial_evidence.family: For N in 16,32,64,128,256, use '<section><dfn>x</dfn>' repeated N followed by N closing section tags.
adversarial_evidence.derivation: Each carrier calls nearestDefinitionScope and nearestTagAttribute. With carrier i below i section ancestors and no matching inherited attribute, these two loops perform at least 2*sum(i+1)=N*(N+3) ancestor visits, none of which increments work. closeIndexes performs repeated delimiter scans, sourceLines/projectedText repeat range work, and assignContainerPaths scans/sorts tags twice; these are likewise not represented as executed units.
adversarial_evidence.classification: Static and bounded work-accounting counterexample, not a timing benchmark or formal whole-program bound.

findings.title: Valid biblio and definition separator forms remain absent or resolve to the wrong target.
findings.impact: A full-source occurrence denominator would omit valid references and misjoin visible-text references. The empty-slash case contradicts even the declarative rule's stated slash law.

findings.title: Metadata grammar, CSS-family gating, explicit-l override, and datablock consumers still diverge from Bikeshed.
findings.impact: The analyzer both fabricates and omits occurrences under ordinary metadata and datablock forms. Passing one css-no witness and one l-in-pre definition witness does not close the source-state repair.

findings.title: Bare manual links, empty href semantics, and inherited heading definition attributes remain incorrect.
findings.impact: Whole occurrence families are still incomplete, while a present empty href can be promoted to a manual link. Entity decoding is repaired on the frozen forms but the parsed-attribute model is not complete.

findings.title: Underline rows remain reusable as later heading content on a neighboring ATX path.
findings.impact: Heading and downstream operation ownership can still be fabricated by a three-line bounded source despite the exact SETEXT_CONSUMED witness passing.

findings.title: Hostile but in-scope ledger values still escape analyzeSource as native TypeErrors.
findings.impact: The explicit INPUT contract and evidence claim are false beyond six handpicked shapes. A corpus launcher cannot treat analysis as a total nonthrowing boundary.

findings.title: The verifier is an exact nineteen-source witness table plus self-consistency checks, not an independent semantic oracle.
findings.impact: Five required blueprint relations can be falsified while the verifier returns GREEN. The contract's rule texts are inert and exact whole-source lookup is neither complete nor independent semantic derivation.

findings.title: Separate counters exist, but both the verifier check and the geometric families omit material repeated work.
findings.impact: The honest no-formal-bound disclaimer is retained, but the emitted analyzer/verifier units cannot support even bounded work-accounting claims: the reported total can be zeroed and a quadratic ancestor family appears linear in the counters.

total_tranche.analysis: The exact repair3 tooling cannot seed the 168-source occurrence-to-owner denominator. It still omits valid reference and manual-link forms, misclassifies source states and empty attributes, can throw at the option boundary, and can receive a green verdict after required relations are corrupted. No broad tranche conclusion follows.

wave.analysis: The repair3 wave is byte-reproducible and closes several exact repair2 witnesses, but fresh bounded sources reopen reference grammar, Bikeshed settings, datablock, carrier, Setext, no-throw, oracle, and work-accounting gates. It is not ready for a denominator traversal.

feature.analysis: Narrow duplicate-stack, entity decoding, ledger-status, union-collision, nested-section owner, and uppercase-URL repairs are retained as local green facts only. The occurrence-owner feature remains semantically incomplete and independently unverified.

required_repairs_before_rechallenge: Parse the complete reviewed inside grammar: biblio visible text, definition empty slash, type suffixes, and visible-text suffixes must be separated from target identity before validation and joining.
Parse Markup Shorthands as its comma-separated metadata grammar, gate every CSS shorthand family, make l override disabled categories, and prevent non-metadata datablocks from changing settings.
Apply a single datablock ancestry policy to every consumer so tag-derived links, headings, carriers, and operations cannot leak from opaque DSL payloads without an explicit reviewed DSL result.

Emit every href-less a manual autolink with default text/type semantics, distinguish absent attributes from present empty-string attributes, and apply closest inherited definition attributes per field when recognizing heading carriers.
Consume heading underline/thematic rows under the complete block grammar, including paths adjacent to ATX headings and empty projected content.

Close the no-throw boundary around Array.isArray, coercive regex/template operations, revoked proxies, and hostile nested ledger field values; run analyzer and verifier on every hostile row rather than skipping one.

Replace exact whole-source semantic lookup with an independently derived general relation checker. Recompute ancestry, URL joins, last eligible heading ownership, required ledger bijection, and work totals instead of trusting analyzer summaries.

Count or explicitly inventory repeated delimiter, line/range, container-sort, projected-text, and ancestor-walk work; add the nested-carrier family. Preserve the current no-formal-bound and no-benchmark disclaimers until a real proof/measurement exists.
